name: split-text
title: Split Text
description: Splits text into characters, words and lines for Motion animations without breaking its kerning: staggered reveals, line masks, nested links and emphasis, resize re-splits and screen reader text.

author: dimi (dimicx) <https://github.com/dimicx>

props.name: options
props.type: { type?: "chars" | "words" | "lines" | "chars,words" | "words,lines" | "chars,lines" | "chars,words,lines"; mask?: "lines" | "words" | "chars"; charClass?: string; wordClass?: string; lineClass?: string; propIndex?: boolean; disableKerning?: boolean; resplitDebounceMs?: number; restoreLigaturesOnRevert?: boolean }
props.description: What to split, and an optional clipping mask around each line, word or character for reveals. Kerning is compensated unless `disableKerning`.

props.name: variants / initial / animate / exit
props.description: Motion variants. A variant is a flat target, a function of `{ index, count, globalIndex, lineIndex, wordIndex, custom, isPresent }`, or per-type targets (`chars`, `words`, `lines`, `wrapper`). `initial` is applied right after the split.

props.name: whileInView / whileOutOfView / whileScroll / whileHover / whileTap / whileFocus
props.description: Variants for the viewport, a scroll-driven progress (`scroll` sets offset, axis and container), hover, tap and focus.

props.name: transition
props.description: Default transition; a variant's own or a function's returned transition wins. `delay: stagger(...)` staggers the parts.

props.name: delayScope
props.description: Whether a stagger counts across all parts of a type or within each parent (line or word).

props.name: onSplit / onResplit / onViewportEnter / onViewportLeave / onRevert
props.description: Callbacks with the split elements. Return an animation (or a promise) with `revertOnComplete` to restore the original markup when it finishes.

props.name: autoSplit
props.description: Split again when the container's width changes, so lines follow the new wrap. `animateOnResplit` replays the reveal.

props.name: viewport
props.type: { once?: boolean; amount?: number | "some" | "all"; leave?: number | "some" | "all"; margin?: string; root?: React.RefObject<Element> }
props.description: Viewport observer options for `whileInView` and the viewport callbacks; `resetOnViewportLeave` re-applies the initial state when it leaves.

props.name: initialStyles / initialClasses
props.description: Inline styles or classes applied to the parts right after the split (callback mode).

props.name: waitForFonts
props.description: Wait for `document.fonts.ready` before splitting, so kerning is measured on the real font. The wrapper is hidden until then.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Reduced motion handling. With `"user"` a visitor who prefers reduced motion gets the animate variant's end state at once (Labs default; upstream animates).

props.name: as
props.description: The wrapper element. Other Motion props pass through to it; `dir` defaults to `"auto"`.

a11y: The split parts are aria-hidden. Headings, landmarks and interactive elements get an aria-label with the full text; other elements keep a visually hidden copy of the text, links and emphasis included, so the text is read once, as words, not letter by letter.
With the default reducedMotion="user", a visitor who prefers reduced motion sees the end state with no movement.
The wrapper sets dir="auto", so Latin text inside a right-to-left page keeps its letter and word order (the parts are inline blocks, which the page direction would otherwise reorder).
It renders text only and adds no role or focus stop; whileFocus and whileTap apply only when the wrapped element is itself focusable or pressable.
